summary: Verified 3 audit-gap closures for iter 116: LF-2 dedicated router (public status, templates/chains listing, generate-chain, list-per-participant, patch/get/send draft, guards), BC-2 dashboard projection widget, and multi-step wizard LF-2 hand-offs on both PSW-1 decision walkthrough and hardship walkthrough. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed. Frontend: BC-2 widget renders on /app with all required testids and Full View link -> /app/pacing. Hardship walkthrough final step shows LF2ChainGenerator with chain_key=hardship_full and successfully generated 2 drafts (provider + my_aged_care). PSW-1 walkthrough (Save walkthrough on step 5) transitions to step 6 done state with psw1-lf2-chain block; LF2ChainGenerator with chain_key=psw_switch_full generated 2 drafts (formal notice + welcome letter).

issues: Loading label reads 'Generating,' with a trailing comma instead of an ellipsis. Cosmetic only. Mirrors the same pattern already noted in HardshipWalkthrough Save Notes button ('Saving,').

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Replace 'Generating,' with 'Generating...' in /app/frontend/src/components/LF2ChainGenerator.jsx line 81. Same tiny bug pattern exists in HardshipWalkthrough Save button.

(Optional) LF-2 send_draft endpoint returns 200 with {sent:true|false, result:...}. When Resend is live but recipient isn't verified, result is mocked. Test asserts only shape, not delivery. Consider explicit 'mocked:true' surfacing in UI if user tries to send to non-verified addresses.
critical_code_review_comments: lf2.py _fill_template: unused inner _lookup function and unused imports (Callable ok). No effect on behavior.
lf2.py generate_chain returns drafts with created_at ISO but does not include updated_at; get_draft returns updated_at only if a patch has occurred. Minor inconsistency, non-blocking.

lf2.py send_draft happily marks status='send_failed' but does NOT surface the exception detail beyond the delivery_result. UI has no dedicated retry endpoint. Consider a /retry or explicit send-status polling if send failures become common.
LF2ChainGenerator falls back to /core/participants when participantIdParam is null; if user has no participant (fresh signup), UI shows disabled button with no explanatory text.
BC2Projection: silent null return on error hides diagnostics from users. Could show a small 'Unable to load projection' pill instead.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_iter116 provider switches (CoA, CoB, CoC) for Cathy's Dorothy participant; 2 LF-2 chains (hardship_full x1, psw_switch_full x1) with 4 total drafts, one draft patched with recipient e2e-test@example.com and successfully dispatched via LF-2 send endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LF-2 router has 8 endpoints under /api/lf2/*. Status is public; all others require auth + core1 access. Chain generation guards check core1_assert_access which returns 403 for cross-household, and returns 404 (no data leak) for participants that don't exist under the caller's household. Wizard integration: hardship walkthrough auto-lands on the final step showing hardship-handoffs section which renders LF2ChainGenerator unconditionally. PSW-1 decision walkthrough has 5 visible steps; Save walkthrough on step 5 submits POST /api/psw1/switches/{sid}/decision-walkthrough and transitions to step 6 with psw1-walkthrough-done + conditional psw1-lf2-chain (only when final_decision === 'proceed_with_switch'). LF2ChainGenerator button testid follows pattern 'lf2-chain-generate-<chain_key>' and result card is 'lf2-chain-result' with draft rows 'lf2-chain-draft-{i}'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no failures observed. All requested audit-gap endpoints and UI hand-offs behave per spec.
